entry.author: Hawke's Bay Regional Council
entry.summary:
Have you got moth plant on your property and want to remove it?

In this video, our Senior Biosecurity Advisor Warren Pegley, breaks down what moth plant looks like, why it’s a problem in Napier and Hastings urban areas, and the simple things you can do to help slow it down, especially before it starts producing big pods packed with fluffy seeds that can blow long distances.

You’ll learn to easily identify moth plant, plus practical and safe removal tips you can use on your property.

If you’ve ever wondered why Regional Council isn’t tackling every plant in town, Warren explains why the focus is on containing spread outside urban centres and why community action on properties and along fence lines really does make a difference.

Learn more about moth plant on our Pest Hub. Visit: https://www.hbrc.govt.nz/environment/pest-control/pest-hub/pests/pest/107?family=15
